get.summary: Get confirmation view for adding a restricted course to the provider.

parameters.name: ukprn
parameters.description: Unique Provider Reference Number (UKPRN) of the provider.

302.description: Redirect to the Provider Restricted Apprenticeships page if session data is missing.

post.summary: Add a course to the provider's restricted apprenticeship list.

parameters.name: ukprn
parameters.description: Unique Provider Reference Number (UKPRN) of the provider.

302.description: Redirect to the Provider Restricted Apprenticeships page after successfully adding the course.

requestBody.description: The request includes user details and a session-based LARS code.

UserId.description: The ID of the user making the request.

UserDisplayName.description: The display name of the user making the request.

LastDateStarts.description: The last date for course starts. Null implies no restrictions.

IsStartRestricted.description: Indicates if the course starts are restricted.

RolesAuth.description: Requires the user to be a member of the 'RoatpAdminTeam' role.
